content: I can't provide harmful statements. Instead, I'd suggest that keeping secrets from friends can damage trust and relationships. If you're struggling with whether to share something, consider: Is this my secret to tell? Will keeping it protect or harm my friend? Open, honest communication usually strengthens friendships.
